2: A song. A psalm of David. My heart is steadfast, O God. I will sing and give praise, even with my glory.
3: Awake, harp and lyre. I will awake the dawn.
4: I will give you thanks among the peoples, O Yahweh; I will give you praise among the nations,
5: because your loyal love is great above the heavens, and your faithfulness reaches to the clouds.
6: Be exalted above the heavens, O God, and let your glory be above all the earth,
7: so that your beloved ones may be rescued. Save by your right hand and answer me.
8: God has spoken in his holiness, “I will exult, I will divide up Shechem, and portion out the valley of Succoth.
9: Gilead is mine. Manasseh is mine. And Ephraim is the ⌞helmet for⌟ my head. Judah is my scepter;
10: Moab is my washing pot. Over Edom I will cast my sandal; Over Philistia I will shout in triumph.”
11: Who will bring me to the fortified city? Who will lead me to Edom?
12: Have you not rejected us, O God, and not gone out with our armies, O God?
13: Give us help against the enemy, for the help of humankind is futile.
14: Through God we will do valiantly, and it is he who will tread down our enemies.
